test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will fill in the blank and complete the series.

6, 44, 9, 42, __, 40
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The numbers at odd places are increased by 3.

 The numbers at even places are decreased by 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad3efbbb869145bd797c0b547c993b438e4bcc08de0a8aed32909b495dfe2326.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
